description: A type is a reusable element that can be connected with other types over connectors.

typology.description: Id of the typology that owns this type.

families.description: Ids of connector families this type references.

items.description: A connector is a connection point (with a direction) of a type.
A locator is meta-data for grouping connectors.

subgroup.description: The optional sub-group of the locator. No sub-group means true.

items.description: A attribute is a key value pair with an an optional definition.

value.description: The optional value [ text | url ] of the attribute. No value is equivalent to true.

unit.description: The optional unit of the value of the attribute.
